name: A/2 Student Visa

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national admitted to an Israeli institution of higher education or yeshiva applies for an A/2 visa at an Israeli embassy or consulate.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Letter of admission and certificate of acceptance from the institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Letter of admission and certificate of acceptance (full name, program/school name, program length) from an Israeli university or yeshiva.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an Israeli institution of higher education or yeshiva.

requirements.blocker_text: Three recent bank statements demonstrating financial capability.
International health insurance covering the study period.

evidence_required.document: Letter of admission / certificate of acceptance
Proof of Israeli residence (apartment, dormitory, etc.)
Original birth certificate and copies of both parents' passports

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, multiple entries/exits, renewable for the duration of study

sources.title: embassies.gov.il (Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Atlanta consulate) -- Entry visas for university or yeshiva students (A/2): valid up to 1 year with multiple entries/exits, work explicitly prohibited, detailed document list including 3 months' bank statements, international health insurance, and proof of Israeli residence

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Israel). Modeled PUBLISHED -- directly and comprehensively tier-1 sourced (an Israeli government consular page). Work is explicitly and unambiguously prohibited on this visa, a stricter rule than several other countries' student routes in this dataset that allow limited part-time work.
